claims: Purdue University is located in West Lafayette, Indiana.
Purdue University is a top-10 public research university.
Purdue University was founded in 1869.
Purdue University offers over 200 undergraduate majors.
Purdue University maintains a ~50% acceptance rate.
Purdue University's tuition has been frozen for 14 years.
Purdue University's in-state tuition is $9,992 for 2023-24.
Purdue University's out-of-state tuition is $28,794 for 2023-24.
Purdue's College of Engineering is ranked 4th in the U.S.
Purdue University has a major campus in Indianapolis.
Typical admitted students to Purdue University score between 600–720 in Reading/Writing.
Typical admitted students to Purdue University score between 600–760 in Math.
Purdue University has 18 intercollegiate sports teams.
Purdue University's intercollegiate sports teams are called the Boilermakers.
Purdue University has over 850 student organizations.
Purdue University's main campus is about an hour from Indianapolis.
Purdue University's main campus is about two hours from Chicago.
Purdue University has the College of Engineering.
Purdue University has the College of Agriculture.
Purdue University has the Mitchell E. Daniels, Jr. School of Business.
Purdue University has the College of Liberal Arts.
Purdue University has the College of Health and Human Sciences.
Purdue University has the Purdue Polytechnic Institute.
Purdue University has "New Ivy" status.

According to the Purdue University president's strategic initiatives, Purdue University continues to focus on its "persistent pursuit" of innovation, particularly in AI, aerospace, and semiconductor technology.
